color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CTS Spring / document store
Upload the file in CTS. Send the version ID, storage key,
SHA-256, borrower context and Idempotency-Key.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
DPS API - POST /dps/v1/jobs
Validate service access, document and request.
Return a job ID. A repeated request can reuse it.

div.style: color: rgb(19, 61, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
MySQL job queue - CTS target: cov_monitoring
dps_document, dps_job and dps_event_feed.
A worker claims the job under a timed lease.

div.style: color: rgb(77, 52, 27) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
What does
the job read?

div.style: color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Read accepted file bytes from CTS storage
Verify hash. Look for a reusable page model by
tenant, source hash, format and pipeline version.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Read a JSON manifest
DRAFT_COMMENTARY or RECONCILE_SET.
These jobs bypass document parsing.

div.style: color: rgb(77, 52, 27) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Matching
page model?

div.style: color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p: Load the saved page model

div.style: color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Isolated parser - Unix socket, no network
Read native text and use OCR where needed.
Large, poorly read or resource-limited jobs can move
to the HEAVY worker and its Docling parser.

div.style: color: rgb(19, 61, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Write page-model.json.gz to derived file storage
Page text, numbers, quality and available layout.
MySQL dps_artifact stores the path and hashes.

div.style: color: rgb(77, 52, 27) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
How is the reading
workflow chosen?

div.style: color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Classify the page model
Rules score the document type. The small Azure route
can cross-check it. Map the detected type to a pack.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p: Use the pack named by the job type

div.style: color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Analyze type, identifiers and legibility
Match identifiers through CTS where available.
Return analysis and mapping signals.

div.style: color: rgb(48, 34, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 400px;

span.p:
Document skill packs
Agreement, guarantee, trust deed or restatement → covenants
Sanction letter → sanction · Amendment → amendment_diff
Waiver / consent → waiver · Statement → statement_lines
Compliance certificate → certificate
Agreement, sanction and amendment can also use schedule_terms.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Manifest skill packs
commentary drafts from supplied data.
reconcile_set combines earlier reviewed results.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Read with rules first
Find candidate fields and evidence. Select relevant pages.
For agreements, scope AI reads to financial covenants,
undertakings, reporting and events of default.

div.style: color: rgb(77, 52, 27) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Does this workflow use
a model for this read?

div.style: color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Check and combine findings
Validate JSON, page and quote. Check numeric support.
Repair invalid output once where supported. Discard
unsupported findings and keep review warnings.

div.style: color: rgb(48, 34, 79) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Build bounded reads using pack prompt and schema
CTS Compose defaults to up to 4 concurrent reads per job.
Reads share a job budget and cancellation checks.

div.style: color: rgb(48, 34, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 400px;

span.p:
Azure gateway and Document Agent
strong = extraction · vision = supported image reads
Tool-enabled reads use a fresh CrewAI agent with the
pack's allowed tools. Other readers can call the gateway directly.

div.style: color: rgb(53, 76, 98) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Allowed tools, depending on the skill
Page text, text search, definitions, CTS identifier lookup,
covenant library and formula validation.

div.style: color: rgb(19, 61, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Persist the result revision and job outcome
MySQL dps_run stores result JSON. dps_event_feed
records updates. Page previews are saved on demand
in derived storage and indexed by dps_artifact.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Spring fetches status, result and page evidence
Poll by job ID or event sequence. Push is optional.
CTS can submit field decisions and close the review.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 41, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Recorded outcome
dps_review_decision preserves field actions.
dps_statement_value stores published statement figures.
CTS applies approved data under its own business rules.

div.style: color: rgb(53, 76, 98) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CTS Compose reference configuration
2 API replicas · 3 STANDARD workers · 1 HEAVY worker
4 parser sidecars, one per worker.

div.style: color: rgb(53, 76, 98) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Model controls
Allowed Azure routes, supported text masking, route pause,
token and rate limits. Optional answer cache defaults to off.

div.style: color: rgb(53, 76, 98) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Support and audit
Job attempts, processing traces, AI usage, tool fingerprints
and audit history stay in DPS. CTS retains its own records.

svg.text: DPS architecture - CTS upload to reviewed result
